_readme: CARD SCANS TCGDEX DOES NOT HAVE, HOTLINKED FROM TCGPLAYER INSTEAD.
Every card picture on this site comes from assets.tcgdex.net, and a handful
of real cards are simply not in it. Three of them are logged hits, so the
Hall of Fame drew them as a grey 'No scan' box with the name in it while a
THIS IS A PIN LIST AND NOT A FALLBACK. Nothing is guessed: each entry names
the TCGplayer product the owner linked, and the id in that url is what the CDN
path is built from. A card is added here only after its TCGdex url has been
checked and found to 404, so an entry can never quietly shadow a scan we
KEYS ARE '<corpus set name>|<collector number>', which is the pair
public/data/printings uses and the pair a rip log row resolves to. Not the
card name: two sets can print the same name and only the pair is unique.
TWO RENDITIONS, BOTH MEASURED 23 Aug 2026. `_200w` is 13-29KB and `_in_
1000x1000` is 135-170KB, both answer 200 with and without a referrer. They
carry NO width or height, because tcgplayer-cdn pads to a fixed canvas and
imgDims() in shared/format.mjs returns nothing for that host on purpose.
To add one: find the card on tcgplayer.com, take the number out of the
/product/<id>/ path, and record why TCGdex has no scan for it.
